title: Frequency Output
text: Write to one or multiple frequency or PWM output channels, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Output channels} selects frequency output, {Output signal frequency source} sets the source of output frequency, {Frequency} sets the output frequency, {Frequency initial value} sets the frequency that the board generates before execution starts, {Frequency final value} sets the frequency that the board generates after execution ends, {Output signal duty source} sets the source of output signal duty cycle, {Duty} sets the time during which the output signal, {Duty initial value} sets the duty cycle of the board before execution starts and {Duty final value} sets the duty cycle of the board after execution ends. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Duty Cycle

params.values: Register a board < no board selected > (default)

params.values: Specify source of output frequency (Hz) external (default) | internal

params.values: Specify the frequency that the board generates before execution starts scalar

params.values: Specify source of output signal duty cycle internal (default) | external
